technique_name: What are some of the benefits of renewable energy?
description: The main benefits of renewable energy include a decrease in greenhouse gas emissions, cost savings on electricity, energy independence, improved energy security, and economic development. Renewable energy also has greater reliability than fossil fuels, as well as being a sustainable, clean, and renewable source of energy.
